policy_title: Restrict Sex Offenders from Changing Names
stated: The Conservative Party will ensure sex offenders cannot evade justice or conceal their identity by restricting them from changing their names.

source.quote: We will ensure sex offenders cannot evade justice or conceal their identity by restricting sex offenders from changing their names.

bearing_set.reason: Restricting sex offenders from changing names directly bears on public safety and the effectiveness of the justice system by preventing identity concealment and evasion of monitoring.

Removes a specific civil/legal right (to change one's name) from a defined class of convicted persons, bearing concretely on the civil liberties and legal-rights framework indicator within O9's strict scope.

Removes an existing legal right (changing one's name) from a defined class of people (convicted sex offenders) by state mandate — a concrete restriction on identity autonomy and freedom from state coercion, even if applied post-conviction.

membership_note: Classic O5-improves / O10-worsens pair: the same restriction that enhances public safety (O5) imposes an additional coercive constraint on a specific group's personal freedom (O10). Both bearings are non-negligible and mechanistically distinct.
